breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that only RANS with k-Epsilon should be used, explicitly states 'The turbulence modeling approach will be Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) using the standard k-Epsilon model,' and explicitly states 'The `LES` block will be removed from the `constant/turbulenceProperties` file.' This matches the ground truth which only includes the RAS block and does not include LES.
